reason: Mechanism is real and broader than stated: mcp-endpoint.json is written only on a healthy boot and nothing in src-tauri or sidecar ever removes it, so it goes stale after EVERY normal quit as well as a failed relaunch, and docs/MCP_INTEGRATION.md:53-54's 'a stale file never points at a dead port' is false. Downgraded medium->low: the outcome is a loopback connection-refused for an external MCP client when the sidecar is not up, the same thing it would see with no file; no wrong data, no safety impact. Fix: remove the file at the start of start_main_sidecar and on app exit.
